name: Sven Simon - Proposition de décision (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the revision of the Framework Agreement on relations between the European Parliament and the European Commission
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved a new cooperation agreement with the European Commission. It updates a deal from 2010. The Commission promises to give Parliament more information, earlier and in more detail, about new laws, trade talks and emergency measures. Commissioners must show up more often in Parliament to answer questions. Parliament also gets a stronger say when it asks the Commission to propose new laws. The deal does not change the powers the treaties give each institution.

- **What changes:** More information and more Commissioner appearances in Parliament; stronger follow-up to Parliament's law requests.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission and the European Parliament, and through them EU citizens.
- **What happens next:** The Presidents of both institutions sign it, and it is published in the Official Journal.
